name: Issuer CSD Report 1
definition: Identifies each issuer CSD (central securities depository) included in the report.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the issuer CSD (central securities depository) for which data is reported.

OverallTotal.name: Overall Total
OverallTotal.definition: Overall aggregated total value and volume of |- settled and failed and total of internalised settlement instructions, and|- failed rate of internalised settlement instructions|performed during the period covered by the report, for all financial instruments, types of transactions, types of clients and cash transfers.

FinancialInstrument.name: Financial Instrument
FinancialInstrument.definition: Classification of financial instrument covering the types of financial instruments as defined in the relevant regulation.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Classification of securities movements according to the categories defined in the relevant legislation.

ClientType.name: Client Type
ClientType.definition: Classification of a settlement internaliser's clients as referred to in the relevant legislation.

TotalCashTransfer.name: Total Cash Transfer
TotalCashTransfer.definition: Covers cash payments related to securities transactions.
